title: A blood signature that flags lung cancer years early
paper_title: Plasma signals of lung tumor promotion for molecular cancer prevention.
description: Researchers found a 14-protein signature in blood that can signal lung cancer risk more than five years before diagnosis. The episode follows how that signal showed up in smokers and pollution-exposed people, and why it might help pick who benefits from inflammation-blocking prevention drugs.

title: Adding glutamine to first-line pancreatic cancer therapy
paper_title: L-Glutamine in combination with first-line gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel in advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: an open-label, single-arm, phase 1 GlutaPanc trial.
description: A small phase 1 trial tested FDA-approved L-glutamine on top of standard gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel in newly diagnosed advanced pancreatic cancer. Hosts unpack why a nutrient supplement would shrink tumors, what the safety data showed, and how early survival numbers compared with historical chemotherapy alone.

title: A tumor protein that starves the body
paper_title: Tumor-Secreted ADAMTSL4 Activates Latent TGFβ1 to Drive Cancer Cachexia.
description: Cancer cachexia is the wasting syndrome that has no approved treatment. This paper argues that a tumor-secreted protein, ADAMTSL4, turns on TGF-beta in muscle and fat, and that blocking it spared tissue in mice.
